text:
lucas.sales: Quick Q from MapleTrust: before we sign the POC SOW they want a short runbook for BYO-HSM cutover that supports monthly automated rotation, a dual-custodian ceremony option, and permission to run a scoped pen-test. Can ops/sec confirm constraints and a customer-facing summary we can paste into the security questionnaire?

rahul.engineering: We support BYO-HSM via per-tenant HSM-proxy. Rotation can be API-driven with staged overlap (recommend 5-10m). Typical perf: add ~5-25ms on unwrap when cache misses occur; cached prefixes are cheap. Dual-custodian ceremonies are performed external to our control plane but we can provide signed attestation nonces at each step and host the orchestration call.

mei.security: For the questionnaire: short answer: "Redwood does not natively provide automated split-custody HSM workflows inside the hosted control plane. We provide a documented ceremony script, attestation artifacts, signed rotation records, and can run the ceremony with customer operators; for fully automated split-custody we offer professional services to implement per-customer solutions." Also need attestation certs, firmware/FIPS evidence, and monthly signed rotation logs for their audit.

dave.sre: Runbook sketch: preflight (whitelist staging proxy IPs, validate attestation chain), staging dry-run with simulated custodians, production cutover in a 30-60m window with staged traffic (10%->50%->100%) and 5m stabilization, rollback by remapping to old KEK. I'll provide the exact commands and rollback snippets. Pen-tests allowed against staging/proxy and control-plane only with signed pentest agreement and 5 business days notice. No destructive tests on production.

kevin.solutions: Pricing note: BYO-HSM POC surcharge ~+18-22% depending on ops packaging. If they want Redwood to staff the ceremony (onsite or remote), that's a PS line item. I'll draft a short SOW appendix and pricing delta.

lucas.sales: Could someone paste a tiny ops-friendly connectivity check for their infra team?

rahul.engineering: Paste: 
```bash
# tls client auth test for HSM proxy (replace host and certs)
curl -v --cert client.crt --key client.key \
  https://hsm-proxy.maple-staging.redwood.ai/health \
  --cacert /path/to/attestation_root.pem
# expected: {"status":"ok","attestation_nonce":"<nonce>"}
```

mei.security: Also include this one-liner for Q12 (multi-custodian): "We do not ship built-in multi-custodian HSM automation. We provide ceremony scripts, audit artifacts, and can deliver PS to implement split-control if required."

dave.sre: Action items: me - runbook + pentest scheduling form; rahul - sample snippets + perf note; mei - one-paragraph Q12 reply + evidence checklist; kevin - SOW appendix + price delta. Lucas - you'll send to the customer?

lucas.sales: Yep, I'll consolidate and send to MapleTrust PM by EOD. redwood-bot: File uploaded: MAPLE_POC_BYOHSM_EVIDENCE.zip

lucas.sales: Thanks team, ping here if anything blocks the EOD deliverable.
